questions.question: A car takes 4 hours to cover a distance if it travels at a speed of 60 km/h. What should be its speed (in km/h) to cover the same distance in 1.5 hours?
questions.solution:
Given:

A car takes 4 hours to cover a distance if it travels at a speed of 60 km/h. 

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Covered distance = 4 × 60 = 240 km

Now, to complete 240 km in 1.5 hours, the speed = 240/1.5

⇒ 160 km/h

∴ Its speed to cover the same distance in 1.5 hours should be 160 km/h.

questions.question: The sum of the radius of the base and height of a solid cylinder is 17 cm. If the total surface area of the solid cylinder is 748 cm², then the height of the cylinder is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The sum of the radius of the base and height of a solid cylinder is 17 cm.

The total surface area of the solid cylinder is 748 cm2.

Concept used:

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

where r = Radius of the base, h = height

π = 22/7

Calculation:

Let the radius of the base and height be R and H respectively.

Total surface area = 2πR(R + H)

According to the question,

⇒ R + H = 17 ....(1)

⇒ 2πR(R + H) = 748

⇒ 2πR × 17 = 748 (From 1)

⇒ πR = 748/34

⇒ 22R/7 = 22

⇒ R = 7

Putting R = 7 in (1),

⇒ 7 + H = 17

⇒ H = 17 - 7

⇒ H = 10

∴ The height of the cylinder is 10 cm.

questions.question: A train X of length 345 m running at 50 km/h crosses another train Y running at 76 km/h in the opposite direction in 22 seconds. Train Y will cross a bridge of length 905 m in:
questions.solution:
Given:

A train X of length 345 m running at 50 km/h crosses another train Y running at 76 km/h in the opposite direction in 22 seconds.

Concept used:

Relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds while two bodies are coming from the opposite direction.

While a train crosses a bridge, it crosses the sum of its length and the length of the bridge.

When a train completely crosses another train, it basically crosses the sum of the lengths of the two trains.

Time × Speed = Distance

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

Calculation:

50 km/h = 50 ÷ 18/5 = 125/9 m/s

76 km/h = 76 ÷ 18/5 = 190/9 m/s

Relative speed = 125/9 + 190/9

⇒ 35 m/s

According to the concept,

The sum of lengths of Train X and Y = 22 × 35

⇒ 770 m

Length of the train Y = 770 - 345

⇒ 425 m

Now, time taken by Train Y to cross a bridge length of 905 m = (425 + 905) ÷ 190/9

⇒ 63 seconds

**∴ Train Y will cross a bridge of length 905 m in 63 seconds.**

questions.question: The average weight of some persons in a group is 70 kg. When 15 persons with average weight 60 kg leave the group or 15 persons with average weight 87.5 kg join the group, then the average weight of persons in the group in both the cases is equal. How many persons were there in the group, initially?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average weight of some persons in a group is 70 kg. 

When 15 persons with an average weight of 60 kg leave the group or 15 persons with an average weight of 87.5 kg join the group, then the average weight of persons in the group in both cases is equal.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Let the number of persons in the group be N.

Initially total weight of the persons in the group = 70N

According to the question,

(70N + 15 × 87.5)/(N + 15) = (70N - 15 × 60)/(N - 15)

⇒ (N + 15)/(N - 15) = (70N + 1312.5)/(70N - 900)

Applying the Componendo-Dividendo method,

⇒ (N + 15 + N - 15)/(N + 15 - N + 15) = (70N + 1312.5 + 70N - 900)/(70N + 1312.5 - 70N + 900)

⇒ 2N/30 = (140N + 412.5)/2212.5

⇒ N/15 = (140N + 412.5)/2212.5

⇒ N = (140N + 412.5)/147.5

⇒ 147.5N = 140N + 412.5

⇒ 7.5N = 412.5

⇒ N = 412.5/7.5

⇒ N = 55

∴ 55 persons were there in the group initially.

questions.question: In how much time will a sum of money double itself at 12% p.a. simple interest?
questions.solution:
Given:

Rate of interest = 12%

Concept used:

1 years = 12 months

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where, P = Principal, R = Rate of interest, T = time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount and time be P and T respectively.

According to the question,

P + (P × 12 × T)/100 = 2 × P

⇒ (P × 12 × T)/100 = P

⇒ 12T/100 = 1

⇒ T = 25/3

Now, 25/3 years = 25/3 × 12

⇒ 25 × 4 months

⇒ 100 months

⇒ 8 years 4 months

∴ It will take 8 years and 4 months.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Let the principal be Rs. 'a'

According to the question,

The sum becomes double itself,

⇒ Amount = 2a

⇒ Simple interest = 2a - a = a

Also, SI = PRT/100

⇒ a = a × 12 × T/100

⇒ T = 100/12 

⇒ T = 8 (1)/(3)

⇒ T = 8 years 4 months.

**Hence, the correct answer is 8 years and 4 months**.

P/2 = Q/3 = R/6 = k(let)

So, P = 2k, Q = 3k, and R = 6k

According to the question,

2k + 3k + 6k = 2310

⇒ 11k = 2310

⇒ k = 2310/11

⇒ k = 210

Now,

P = 2 × 210 = 420

Q = 3 × 210 = 630

R = 6 × 210 = 1260

∴ First, second and third parties have 420, 630, and 1260 people.
